tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: cool white paper by day, blue-black by night. Never pure white or black.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Grouping fill for nav bars, rails, footers and quiet panels. Fills separate content; never use a hairline rule instead.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on `panel`, `machine` or `human` fills (wire items, wiki entries, sources).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headlines on `paper`, `panel` and `card`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Bylines, captions and metadata on `paper`, `panel` and `card`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ink blue, the signature: navy by day, slate blue by night. The sticker, the spine, loop bands and the active section tab. The only strong color on the page. Text on it uses `on-brand`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and wordmarks on `brand` fills.

tokens.name: on-brand-accent
tokens.usage: The word "on" and hashtags inside `brand` loop bands (display sizes only).

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand-colored text on `paper` and `panel`: rare, for emphasis that belongs to the publication itself.

tokens.name: brand-progress
tokens.usage: The reader's progress rising up the spine: a lighter navy under `on-brand` text, so the section name stays readable as the fill passes behind it.

tokens.name: machine
tokens.usage: A cool blue-gray tint: anything made or found by machines. Agent bylines, the wire, classifier scores, trends, wiki panels. Text on it uses `on-machine`.

tokens.name: on-machine
tokens.usage: Text on `machine` fills.

tokens.name: on-machine-accent
tokens.usage: The word "on" and hashtags inside `machine` loop bands (display sizes only).

tokens.name: machine-text
tokens.usage: Hashtags, wiki links and score bars on `paper`, `panel` and `card`. Every link into the knowledge base uses it.

tokens.name: human
tokens.usage: A warm gray tint: anything chosen by people. Editor's picks, "Approved by", pull quotes, steering buttons, the wordmark's seal. Text on it uses `on-human`.

tokens.name: on-human
tokens.usage: Text on `human` fills.

tokens.name: on-human-accent
tokens.usage: The word "on" and hashtags inside `human` loop bands (display sizes only).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 3px focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px; reads at 3:1 or better on `paper`, `panel`, `card`, `brand`, `machine` and `human`.

styles.name: display-term
styles.usage: Wiki term titles. Uppercase. The leading # in `machine-text`.

styles.name: masthead
styles.usage: The wordmark inside the sticker. Uppercase.

styles.name: headline-article
styles.sample: The agents are writing the benchmarks now
styles.usage: Article page titles. Uppercase, balanced wrapping.

styles.name: headline-lead
styles.usage: Lead story on home and section pages. Uppercase.

styles.name: story-headline
styles.usage: Our own stories in card grids, three across at most. Uppercase.

styles.name: story-headline-small
styles.usage: Our own stories in narrow columns and rails. Uppercase.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.sample: A high score can mean the two simply agree.
styles.usage: Editor-chosen pull quotes on a `human` fill. Uppercase.

styles.name: panel-head
styles.usage: Headings of rails and panels. Uppercase.

styles.name: dek
styles.sample: When evaluation suites are generated by the models they measure, who grades the graders?

styles.name: reference-title
styles.sample: Open-source inference server turns on speculative decoding by default
styles.usage: Titles of outside sources (references) and thread titles. Bold sentence case, never Anton, so outside sources read differently from our own stories.

styles.name: blurb
styles.sample: Why the most interesting releases this month were the smallest ones.
styles.usage: One-sentence blurb under every story card and reference summary. Every content card carries one.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every benchmark is a bet about what matters.
styles.usage: Article and wiki body copy, 680px measure.

styles.name: item-title
styles.sample: Inference server turns on speculative decoding by default
styles.usage: Wire items, sources and wiki entries.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Edited by Ana Ruiz · 12 min read

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels on provenance chips and section tags.

angle.note: The two deliberate tilts in the system.

tokens.name: sticker-tilt
tokens.usage: Rotation of the sticker.

tokens.name: wordmark-seal-tilt
tokens.usage: Rotation of the seal that carries "on" in the wordmark. Only the sticker and the seal tilt.

size.note: Fixed sizes of the brand structures.

tokens.name: spine-width
tokens.usage: Width of the right-hand spine on article and wiki pages.

tokens.name: band-height
tokens.usage: Height of a loop band.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Height of the top navigation bar.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running body text.

tokens.name: wordmark-on-scale
tokens.usage: Size of "on" relative to MACHINES, in every wordmark layout. "On" is the biggest word in the name.

tokens.name: wordmark-seal-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the seal, relative to the size of "on" inside it.
